custody_sequence: Source pin and prior/RCT exact splits frozen before first outcome download.
GitHub-hosted Linux one-time run downloaded original pinned CSV.
Source parser parsed FIRST row numeric fields, then rejected repeated data_id at SECOND row before processing any second-row numeric fields.
No random fold produced, no FIT/VALID/DEV model fitted, no pseudo-outcome scored and no donor-vs-control comparison.
After failure, separately checked only pinned public CSV header and column cardinalities to diagnose schema (445 rows, data_id 1 unique, rownames 445 unique).
Original frozen code and prereg NOT modified, outcome not re-scored.
next: Do not rename columns or use rownames as IDs in already consumed GKD-07. If a genuinely separate historical-public dataset is selected, freeze new independent source/ID/split protocol and preflight source identity without accessing heldout outcomes. Source failure is not negative evidence of donor effect.
